config.resampling_boundary: Each already average-referenced/demeaned 2-second window independently resampled with a fixed zero-phase antialias FIR; reflection uses only that window; recenter output within that window. No adjacent-window or record-wide statistics. This is window-offline, not causal sample-by-sample filtering.
config.bridge_interpretation: 500-Hz reference uses original NFFT=1024; grid control uses NFFT=1000, matching 128-Hz NFFT=256 frequency spacing of 0.5 Hz. Both zero-padding grid and resampling can change DE. CNN uses broadband time samples whereas DE uses 4-30 Hz, so this compares representations as well as classifiers.
config.implementation: Local PyTorch EEGNet-8,2; author architecture and Braindecode parameter semantics checked. PyTorch default initialization; no numerical-equivalence claim. Spatial max-norm=1, classifier max-norm=0.25 after each optimizer step. Ordinary Dropout; ELU; mean pooling 4/8; BN eps=0.001 and momentum=0.01.
config.compute_deviation: Planning draft suggested 150 epochs/patience20 and preferred Braindecode. Before real stage3 results, synthetic CPU timing was about 0.50 s/1440-window epoch at4 threads or0.75 s at2; no CUDA available. Freeze a bounded first EEGNet comparison at60 epochs/patience12 with three seeds and all36 targets. A direct PyTorch implementation keeps the training/state audit small. No outcome-driven architecture/seed selection.
config.sampling: Every source subject/condition has30 nonoverlapping windows. Seeded permutation once per epoch, all samples used, no replacement, no dropped tail. Equal total weight per subject and condition; no augmentation.
config.standardization: One mean/std per channel over current source-training windows and time samples (ddof0); scale<=1e-12 replaced with1. Inner validation/outer target never fit a scaler. Store final means/stds and source IDs.
config.early_stopping: Per inner fold: mean of validation-subject BA, first strict improvement >1e-12; stop when epoch>=15 and12 epochs without improvement; cap60. Select median of three best epochs, then initialize from scratch on all35 sources with base seed for that many epochs.
config.seed_schedule: Inner fold RNG=base_seed+10000*(fold_index+1); final RNG=base_seed. Deterministic algorithms enabled; each task has a separate process. Reproducibility is limited to this software/hardware environment.
config.evaluation: Threshold arithmetic probability>=0.5. eval() plus inference_mode; assert all parameters and buffers unchanged. No target labels passed into fitting or inference; only evaluator consumes labels after predictions.
config.aggregation: Report all36 participants for each of3 seeds. Primary CNN descriptive mean: per-participant average of the3 seed-specific BA, then participant mean. Seed variability is not extra participants. Probability-ensemble score optional and separately labelled, not primary.
config.failure_policy: Failed folds saved explicitly; no predictions substituted, no aggregate over only successful folds. Completed fold reuse requires matching config, data, source and environment fingerprint plus output hashes.
config.interpretation: Exploratory on the same36-subject dataset; no confirmatory significance or guaranteed improvement. Report budget-cap hits and source training/validation curves.

environment.compute: CPU; deterministic PyTorch; per-worker thread count in config
